user.title: Connect to the matrix
user.description: The matrix does not report its own model, so choose it here. Another controller may already be connected — that is fine, the hardware accepts several at once.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the matrix.
data_description.port: TCP control port. The default suits every model.
data_description.model: Determines how many inputs and outputs exist.

channels.title: Choose the channels in use
channels.description: Clear anything that is not wired up. Unused channels can be enabled later without losing the ones already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to re-read the matrix. It does not announce changes, so anything altered by another controller appears at the next poll.

error.cannot_connect: No Triad matrix answered. Check the address and that TCP port 52000 is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This matrix is already set up.

init.title: Channels and limits
init.description: Enable the channels in use, cap any zone that should not be driven to full, and set how often the matrix is polled.

data_description.scan_interval: Lower values notice another controller's changes sooner, at the cost of more traffic.
